# openmetadata_metric (Data Source)

Looks up a single OpenMetadata metric by id or fully qualified name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openmetadata_metric" "weekly_revenue" {
  fully_qualified_name = "WeeklyRevenue"
}

output "weekly_revenue_metric_type" {
  value = data.openmetadata_metric.weekly_revenue.metric_type
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Metric fully qualified name. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.
- `id` (String) Metric UUID. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.

### Read-Only

- `custom_unit_of_measurement` (String) Free-form unit used when unit_of_measurement is OTHER.
- `description` (String) Markdown description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `expression_code` (String) Code that computes the metric.
- `expression_language` (String) Language of expression_code.
- `granularity` (String) Time granularity the metric is computed at.
- `metric_type` (String) Calculation performed by the metric.
- `name` (String) Metric name.
- `unit_of_measurement` (String) Unit reported by the metric.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.
